_about: Ben's rulings on flagged directions from the Directions Review page (scripts/directions.mjs). Keyed by the flag key (slug|issue|direction|distance to 25 m). Only keep rulings are stored here: a kept flag is not raised again while the wording stays the same. Changes Ben rules (move, reword, remove, script) are made in Ride with GPS, so they need no entry. If a ride's distances change, the keys of later directions change too; re-key by matching the card's position.
